control_name: Segregation of duties enforced on financial roles
control_objective: Conflicting financial duties are prevented or mitigated by enforcing a segregation-of-duties ruleset across role assignments so that no single user can both initiate and conceal an erroneous or fraudulent transaction.
risk_addressed: A user holding conflicting entitlements can execute and approve the same financial transaction, defeating the control environment and misstating the financial statements.

required_data_elements.business_definition: A user-to-role assignment evaluated against the SoD ruleset.
A financial role granted in the general ledger that participates in SoD rules.
A defined pair of conflicting duties that must not co-exist on one user without mitigation.

method.summary: Evaluate combined IAM and GL role assignments against the approved SoD ruleset and confirm all conflicts are within tolerance and fully mitigated.
steps: Pull user-role assignments from Okta and from the general ledger.
Evaluate the combined assignment set against the approved SoD ruleset.
Count total SoD conflicts identified across the population.
Cross-reference each conflict to a documented mitigation in the mitigation log.
Count conflicts that have no approved mitigation (unmitigated).
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any unmitigated segregation-of-duties conflict on a financially-significant system is a control exception.
thresholds.pass_tolerance: 0 unmitigated conflicts, total conflicts within tolerance
thresholds.warning_threshold: Total conflicts above tolerance though all mitigated

pass_criteria: Total SoD conflicts are within tolerance.
Each conflict traces to an approved mitigation.
fail_criteria: One or more SoD conflicts are unmitigated.
Mitigation evidence cannot be produced for an open conflict.
exception_handling: Remove the conflicting access or approve a documented mitigation before relying on the control.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each quarter before §302 certification.

actions_on_fail: Notify IT Security Manager and Controller
